title: Daylio Mood Recovery After CBT Thought Record
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daylio:entry
| search post_record_mood_delta=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(post_record_mood_delta) as avg_post_record_mood_delta by _time record_completed
| sort - _time
description: Tracks mood recovery after CBT thought records over time and breaks it out by thought-record flag.
value: Mood delta after a completed record is a grounded way to check whether the tool is helping in practice.
implementation: Send mood recovery after CBT thought records events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of mood recovery after CBT thought records by thought-record flag.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how mood recovery after CBT thought records changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
